image_prompt.text: A huge central fountain throwing glowing rainbow water jets, and a gigantic animated leaderboard tower of top donors rising beside it, composed as the plaza's hero builds and framed from the far end of every radiating pathway
The arrival view at the head of a wide neon-lit pathway: the fountain and the leaderboard tower centred against the night skyline, with no backstage geometry, seams, or booth backs in the shot
An open food court and plaza floor with tables where thousands of players congregate and stand around rather than move through
A dense ring of city skyscrapers closing the plaza in on all sides, night-lit and plastered with vibrant neon signage in cyan, magenta, gold and electric blue
Hundreds of customizable donation booths with lit display screens, arranged in neat rows along the plaza floor between the radiating pathways
Elevated performance stages raised above the plaza floor, picked out by spotlights

layout_placement.text: Spawn placed at the outer end of a main radiating pathway and oriented inward at the fountain and leaderboard tower, so a joining player never lands facing the back of the stages or the booth rows

notes: Considered the Hub preset, since the prompt calls this the main hub of a top-5 game, but took Free-Roam Showcase instead: nothing here links out to separate experiences, so the plaza is the destination rather than a launcher and hub-portals' P4 is not earned. Shape kept as the preset's own showcase-freeroam; the prompt's flat, open, radially-pathed plaza is exactly an open space with no prescribed order.
Dropped the preset's collectible-nodes: the plaza is explicitly flat and open with no off-route pockets to tuck hidden badges into, and the prompt asks for nothing collectible.

The central fountain is emitted inside landmark-focal rather than as water-body. It is a composed hero structure, not water that is swum through or that acts as a barrier, so the CHECK route is not earned.

The stated palette (cyan, magenta, gold, electric blue, neon at night) and the extremely-large scale have no option row of their own; they are folded into the option texts above so they survive into the image prompt.
"Hundreds" of donation booths and "thousands" of players are approximations rather than stated figures, so no count is recorded; the words are carried in the text.

would have asked: Sounds like a free-roam showcase plaza — one big open space with no set route, the fountain and the animated leaderboard tower as the hero builds, and the spawn placed so your first view is both of them against the neon skyline. On top of the preset I'd add the food-court gathering floor, the rows of donation booths, the spotlit performance stages, and the ring of neon skyscrapers around it. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?
would have asked: whether the hidden-badge collectibles that normally come with this preset should stay in — dropped here because there is nowhere off-route to hide them on a flat open plaza.

would have asked: whether players actually go inside anything — the booths, the food court, or the surrounding skyscrapers. Built as exteriors and facades, which keeps this on the proven single-pass route; enterable interiors would need a separate indoor build step that isn't ready yet, and I'd note it for when it is.
would have asked: whether the performance stages need raked audience seating around them, which would step the ground up at the back rather than leaving the plaza perfectly flat as described.
would have asked: Anything else you want in the space?
